name: What repair options are available for an uneven subfloor?

mainEntity.name: What repair options are available for an uneven subfloor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repair options for an uneven subfloor depend on the cause and severity. For minor inconsistencies, self-leveling compounds can be poured to create a smooth surface. If the subfloor has isolated dips or humps, shimming with thin material or sanding down high spots may be effective. For more significant issues like damaged or rotting subfloor sections, partial replacement may be necessary. If the unevenness stems from compromised joists or structural elements, these will need to be repaired or reinforced before addressing the subfloor directly. A professional assessment will determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options for uneven subfloor repair include self-leveling compounds, shimming, sanding, or replacing damaged sections. Structural issues may require joist repair first.
